sub: A Balatro-like roguelike deckbuilder. Build poker hands from a garage of 52 cars, stack mods, beat the boss races and win the Grand Prix.
play_lead: The full game runs right here. Your run, settings and statistics are saved in your browser.
play_hint: Best with a mouse and keyboard. Enter plays a hand, Esc opens the menu.
features_lead: All the depth of a deckbuilder, drawn and composed entirely in code.
f1_d: Pair up a Tandem, line up a Gear Shift, park a Same Garage. Score = Chips × Mult.
f2_d: Turbos, drift kings, odometers and more. Each one changes how you score.
f3_d: Foil, Holographic, Polychrome and Negative mods, just like the original game.
f4_d: Permanent bonuses for the whole run: more slots, more hands, cheaper shopping.
f5_d: Open Garage, Dyno, Workshop and Mod packs and take the best card.
f6_d: 8 antes, 12 nasty boss rules, the Grand Prix, then endless mode.
themes_lead: Switch the card art and the suits in the settings. Every name and picture follows your choice.
theme_cars_d: Muscle, JDM, Euro and Offroad cars. Mods are nitro, turbos and gear shifters.
theme_classic_d: Hearts, Diamonds, Spades and Clubs. Kings, Queens, Jacks and Jokers.
screens_lead: Click any picture to see it in full size.
cap1: The Pit Stop: mods, garage cards, booster packs and a sponsor deal
cap2: The Collection shows every mod, item, pack, boss and card back
cap4: Settings: 6 languages, card art, suits, card backs, music and more
how_lead: Easy to learn, hard to put down.
s1_d: Make the best poker hand you can from the 8 cars in your hand.
s2_d: Every scored car adds chips. Mods add Mult.
s3_d: Reach the target score before you run out of hands. Watch out for the boss rule.
s4_d: Spend your winnings at the Pit Stop and build an unstoppable combo.
foot_parody: A fan parody inspired by Balatro
meta_desc: A Balatro-like roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a car. Play free in your browser.
install_lead: Carlatro is an installable web app: it gets its own icon, opens in full screen and works offline after the first start.
install_android_d: Open the game, tap the ⋮ menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install_ios_d: Open the game, tap Share and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install_pc_d: Open the game and click the install icon in the address bar.

theme_who_d: TARDIS, Daleks, Cybermen and Gallifrey. The Doctor, a Time Lady and a Companion. A fan tribute.
cap5: Interactive tutorial: hints point at what to do next
cap6: How to Play: 10 steps with animated pictures
cap7: First launch: pick the language, sound, card look and card back
